contrasts: Primary P2-P1 matched representation assignment effect for correctness and contested action.
System-specific and independent-new-systems-only contrasts, fulfilment calibration separately.
Standalone fixed-case P2-P1 decision response separate from source-modifying B-C-D implementation effect.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No assigned lineage is dropped for timeout, missing packet, assessor failure or bad behaviour. Label corrupted measurement and limit the corresponding identifiable contrast rather than replacing a record.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Mixed systems, imprecise contrast, invalid assessor, review disagreement, unavailable charges or failed parity remain distinct inconclusive/unresolved dispositions.
analysis.missing_data: Unknown token class/rate leaves money missing; missing review leaves architecture unresolved; invalid assessor leaves conformance unknown; delivery/matching failures suspend clean representation contrast. Preserve all ITT records. Case source/state mismatch or missing strict response leaves probe accuracy invalid; never infer a coding-agent action from the packet alone.

diagnostics: Invalid and missing by arm, system and stage.
models.model_or_procedure: Tabulate every probe and paired decision; compute system-balanced within-triad P2-P1 and secondary P2-P0 differences; randomisation inference permutes labels only within actual triads if gates pass. Aggregate the two independent post-D probe sessions as a pair per assigned arm/block; analyse their correct action-change contrast separately from coded implementation outcomes.

assumptions: The score's failure penalty is a stated decision convention.
models.model_or_procedure: Compute Q=min(T,1800) on complete stages and 1800 otherwise; sum C+D plus host acquisition once; report actual elapsed and failure apart from score and equal-system-weighted block differences.
Tabulate each masked rubric finding and disagreement, then a frozen critical no-worse rule after adjudication; preserve unresolved verdicts.

assumptions: Complete class and model SKU attribution.
diagnostics: Coverage table, trace hash, invoice discrepancy and nested-time check.
models.model_or_procedure: Apply dated tariff classes once to uncached input, cache read, cache write, output and attributable host/runner units; reconcile observed bill; no imputed zero.

analysis.multiplicity: Do not declare a broad benefit from whichever endpoint looks best. Any formal simultaneous claim needs pre-specified familywise rule and justified thresholds in a successor registered version.
analysis.preprocessing_lock: Verify source, brief, assignment, packet, assessor and rate hashes, parse all current-run artifacts, classify invalid separately and compute lineage-level vectors before arm mapping is revealed to reviewers. Verify each decision probe source-state digest, fixed action menu, paired case identity and response parser before comparing arms.
robustness_checks: Alternative failure penalties and actual coding elapsed alongside completion.
Exclude fulfilment only for a labelled independent-systems analysis, not as an outcome-chosen exclusion.
Packet length/access sensitivity and full parity audit.
software_and_versions: Pin repository commit, Python dependencies, EAL parser/server, model/agent CLI and workflow revision in the pre-run manifest; exact provider backend revision may be unknown and must be reported.
analysis.stopping_rule: Target all 81 coding episodes and 54 120-second decision sessions irrespective of signs. Stop each nine-episode/six-probe block if the cumulative conditional high Standard API list-rate scenario is unavailable or exceeds USD 15.00 after an invocation; nine parallel blocks have USD 135.00 aggregate conditional caps, not a guaranteed invoice ceiling. Maximum model invocation 152280 seconds (42.3 hours); no efficacy stopping.
analysis.uncertainty: Finite-block randomisation intervals when design and measurement gates pass, exact counts and system-level heterogeneity; no asymptotic three-system population interval. Undetermined effect remains undetermined.

assumptions.failure_consequence: The presentation-only contrast is unidentified; describe the broader content-and-presentation package.
assumptions.statement: P1 and P2 convey the same source facts, qualified propositions, defeaters, status meaning, recommendations and available follow-up information; rendering is the assigned difference.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Canonical FactSet/DecisionContent digest, proposition-level parity audit and adversarial packet cases before allocation and on all delivered episodes.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Cross-arm interference or leakage can account for observed contrasts.
assumptions.statement: Isolated lineages do not see another clone, later brief, hidden test, arm packet or outcome-bearing conversation.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Verify mounts, permitted tools, egress, trial inventory and read traces in every assignment.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Conformance and contested-action claims are suspended for affected systems.
assumptions.statement: The corrected and independent sealed assessors validly distinguish required behaviour, prohibited side effects and their own execution errors.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Pre-freeze brief/probe reconciliation, clean and deliberately faulty reference implementations, independent oracle review and assessor replay against exact snapshots.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Assignment or reviewer expectations can confound the contrast.
assumptions.statement: Random arm permutation is concealed until reviewers seal reports, and agent/model/runner profiles match within each triad and stage.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Validate seed-to-allocation replay, block manifest, invocation metadata and reviewer access; log possible arm-identifying source changes.

assumptions.failure_consequence: Financial totals remain missing or scenario-valued; physical resource observations remain reportable.
assumptions.statement: Provider usage classes and dated rates or bills cover every relevant charge without double-counting cache or nested host work.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Reconcile raw event fields with provider billing rules, rate snapshots and host-runner metering; preserve unknown values.

assumptions.failure_consequence: A renamed fixture cannot be counted as an independent system.
assumptions.statement: The two new systems have distinct source histories and domain architectures, are eligible by frozen pre-outcome rules, and have no dependence on the fulfilment fixture.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Review source provenance, licences, original interfaces, dependencies, assessor ownership and selection log before the freeze.

falsification_checks: Deliberately mismatched source hash, omitted objection and stale facts must fail parity or delivery validation.
negative_controls: Defeated source state with explicit adverse premise must block unsafe completion.
positive_controls: Clean admissible state must allow the correct action, preventing an all-BLOCK solution.
reporting_controls: Durable manifest and artifacts retain every assigned attempt, invalid result, source hash, reviewer form and missing cost class.
researcher_degrees_of_freedom: System selection, task wording, case oracle, packet verbosity, status wording, critical probe set, penalty cap and architecture thresholds require freezing before acquisition.
residual_limitations: Three finite systems do not represent an identified population distribution; agent attention to packet is unobserved, even when delivered.

risks.mechanism: Known fulfilment failures inform task and oracle choice.
risks.prevention: Label it calibration; select new systems and cases by pre-outcome criteria.
risks.residual_risk: Two new systems provide weak transport evidence.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Report new-systems-only contrast and do not fold old v3 outcomes into estimates.

risks.detection: Read/access traces and source inventory audit.
risks.mechanism: Public source or shared workspace reveals hidden probes, future briefs or other clones.
risks.prevention: Isolated staged trial, separate credentials and controlled egress.
risks.residual_risk: Agent network access may expose published host material.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Report compromised blocks; suspend clean causal interpretation.

risks.detection: Positive and negative fixtures with replay of every status.
risks.mechanism: Assessor rejects a valid architecture or counts its own exception as code failure.
risks.prevention: Independent brief/probe oracle review and reference implementations.
risks.residual_risk: Finite probes cannot establish all desired behaviour.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Classify invalid separately and version correction before acquisition.

risks.detection: Ask reviewer to record suspected arm and reason before reveal.
risks.mechanism: Reviewer infers arm from EAL-named code or transcript and interprets source differently.
risks.prevention: Remove sidecars and agent report; blind source IDs and seal independent forms.
risks.residual_risk: Some edits intrinsically reveal provided guidance.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Report broken masking and adjudicator disagreements.

claims.failure_consequence: Weaken the bounded advantage claim, or suspend it if parity or measurement fails.
claims.scope_limit: A finite-system assignment effect of the argument presentation under the registered agent, task, model and runner configuration; not an intrinsic language effect or population effect.
claims.statement: For the registered task sequences, assigning the EAL/2 presentation rather than matched prose changes verified contested decisions and implementation outcomes while preserving critical behaviour.
claims.success_consequence: Strengthen only the bounded differential-presentation claim if parity, correct decision changes, behavioural integrity and measurement gates pass.

claims.failure_consequence: Report slower or more costly outcomes, or missing price, without replacing them with token counts.
claims.scope_limit: Time score is a declared decision metric, not observed remediation labour; price is a measured bill or qualified estimate, not debt principal.
claims.statement: The EAL/2 presentation may alter the failure-penalised change-time score and priced resource expenditure.
claims.success_consequence: Report exact time and money contrasts with uncertainty and separate components.

claims.failure_consequence: Report worse architecture or unresolved review as such.
claims.scope_limit: Source review describes identified paths and obligations; it is not observed future maintenance cost.
claims.statement: Condition-masked reviewers can assess whether the EAL/2 presentation yields no worse specified architecture findings in the registered changes.
claims.success_consequence: Report the reviewer findings and bounded no-worse contrast if both reviews and adjudication are complete.

confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Task and assessor refinement may preferentially fit the known R/W difficulty.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Label fulfilment calibration and report independently new-system results separately.
confounds.description: Prior exposure to observed fulfilment outcome and correction.
confounds.diagnostic: Compare result signs and mechanisms across prior-observed and new systems.
confounds.residual_risk: Only two unobserved systems in first acquisition cannot justify external validity.

confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Different run settings or timing may mimic packet effects.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Matched version/model/effort within triad-stage, balanced start order and full manifests.
confounds.description: Provider model revision, run order, load or CLI drift.
confounds.diagnostic: Audit actual version labels, start times and failed invocations.
confounds.residual_risk: Provider backend revision may be undisclosed.

confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Attention, latency or affordance may account for contrast independently of EAL structure.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Content parity, matched explanation access, length target and sensitivity analysis.
confounds.description: Packet word count or access differences.
confounds.diagnostic: Compare tokenised lengths, tool calls, packet and source hashes.
confounds.residual_risk: Equivalent wording cannot guarantee equal salience.

constructs.definition: Pass/fail/invalid status of independent source-bound functional probes and all-critical completion across a lineage.
constructs.name: Verified implementation behaviour
constructs.scope: Frozen deterministic sequential behaviours and stated critical invariants; not concurrent or live-provider behaviour.
validity_evidence: Independent sealed probes with positive and negative reference implementations are required before freeze.
validity_threats: Incorrect brief-probe correspondence, harness exceptions, finite-case coverage.

constructs.definition: Correct decision and executable effect under a clean premise and a matched defeated premise, including the required change between them.
constructs.name: Contested action response
constructs.scope: Prespecified scenario pairs with an independently reviewed action oracle.
validity_evidence: Independent oracle adjudication and concealed effect probes are required.
validity_threats: A blanket BLOCK strategy, scenario leakage, or a verbal answer differing from code.

constructs.definition: Six source-located rubric findings and reviewer disagreement; no scalar debt estimate.
constructs.name: Specified architecture findings
constructs.scope: Registered system-specific state, effect and event boundaries at each snapshot.
validity_evidence: Two masked reviewers and adjudicator with source locations are required.
validity_threats: Review unmasking, subjective disagreement, distinct valid architectures.

constructs.definition: For each episode Q=min(actual coding seconds,1800) if all due probes pass, otherwise Q=1800; sum C+D plus host packet wall time.
constructs.name: Failure-penalised change-time decision score
constructs.scope: Registered cap and clock start/stop only; not remediation labour or survival restricted mean.
validity_evidence: Monotonic host clock and enforced invocation timeout required.
validity_threats: Cap penalty dominates a failure, queue time omitted, time does not measure human effort.

constructs.definition: Provider model/tool charges plus attributable host/runner charges under a dated rate card or bill, with missing classes preserved.
constructs.name: Priced resource expenditure
constructs.scope: The registered B-C-D acquisition and coding process; future debt excluded.
validity_evidence: Raw token classes and dated provider and runner rates or billing reconciliation required.
validity_threats: Unavailable price or cache-write class, client estimates differing from bill, nested cost double count.

constructs.definition: Equality of all agent-relevant facts, qualifiers, statuses, defeaters, guidance and access, with only prose versus EAL/2 rendering varied.
constructs.name: Representation parity
constructs.scope: P1/P2 packets prepared for identical source state within a triad and stage.
validity_evidence: Canonical content hashes and independent semantic parity review required.
validity_threats: Extra P2 status, length, route labels, tool access or source timing.

constructs.definition: Agent selects one predeclared enum action after reading a fixed public source and one clean or defeated finite-state scenario, in a fresh session after D coding.
constructs.name: Standalone source-state decision response
constructs.scope: The registered six case sources and action oracles, repeated across independent assigned model sessions; unrelated to the candidate D code output.
validity_evidence: Typed source-state fixtures and independent action oracle reviewed before freeze, with positive and defeated cases.
validity_threats: Textual cue leakage, arbitrary action menu, response parsing, repeated identical scenarios, and no behavioural implementation in this probe.

controls.description: P1 matched semantic content in prose.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Failure reclassifies P2-P1 as a mixed-content comparison or invalidates clean representation inference.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: An information difference being misattributed to formal EAL representation.
controls.implementation: Canonical common content and independent proposition audit before every exposure.

controls.description: P0 ordinary source and current brief.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Report secondary package contrast separately from representation effect.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Both packets performing no better than ordinary agent reasoning.
controls.implementation: Run third randomised lineage in every triad.

controls.description: Clean source-backed premise supports provisional action in each contested pair.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: A BLOCK-everything implementation fails the paired outcome.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Blanket refusal being misclassified as sound defeat handling.
controls.implementation: Independently sealed oracle checks correct action and side effects in clean cases.

controls.description: Defeated premise with independent unreconciled or revoked evidence.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Unsafe completion or duplicate external effect is a critical failure.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Agent continuing a once-plausible action after an active attacker.
controls.implementation: Matched clean/defeated source-backed pair and recovery probe per system.

critical_check_contract.amendment: Any brief or assessor change after registration requires a new version and fresh assignments; no outcome-selected check removal.
critical_check_contract.rule: Every listed due check is critical. Each stage must have exactly these named results; candidate import failures and missing/extra findings are not silent noncritical cases.
critical_check_contract.source: Exact due check IDs from corrected host-only assessors at this draft cut; recompute and freeze with source hashes before any coding result.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Any failed parity, hidden oracle or leak gate supersedes this region with DM-004.

claim_effects.rationale: Matched information and assigned representation distinguish the local rival if validity gates hold.
claim_effects.scope_limit: The finite registered systems; fulfilment calibration separately and no population/debt inference.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report finite-system advantage with exact uncertainty; practical benefit requires separately justified margin and precision rather than favourable signs alone.
hypothesis_effects: H-001 locally favoured; H-002 weakened subject to information and attention parity.
decision_matrix.next_action: Replicate on new untouched systems with precision justified by first-wave variance.
decision_matrix.observation_region: Parity and scoring valid; P2 has more correct contested-pair changes than P1 across the registered systems without lower critical conformance; architecture has a sealed no-worse verdict.

claim_effects.rationale: Shared correct action is predicted by explicit information as well as formal presentation.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Only the observed pairs and finite systems.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report shared success and inconclusive differential; equivalence only if a prespecified margin lies entirely outside the uncertainty interval.
hypothesis_effects: H-002 remains live; no evidence of a unique H-001 advantage from a descriptive tie.
decision_matrix.next_action: Seek cases where the rival packages imply different actions, or increase registered information for equivalence.
decision_matrix.observation_region: Both P1 and P2 correctly revise clean/defeated decisions and have compatible conformance; interval does not resolve a material difference.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: If assessor or review invalid, use DM-004 or DM-005 rather than calling harm.

claim_effects.rationale: The tested differential representation trades against protected behaviour or structure.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Registered systems and case pairs; no general absence claim.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Classify critical behavioural harm or worse reviewed structure as adverse; report time/money components separately and do not average harm away.
hypothesis_effects: H-003 gains local support; H-001 weakened.
decision_matrix.next_action: Inspect exact failed premise and source path before another versioned test.
decision_matrix.observation_region: Valid parity/scoring and P2 causes more unsafe action or critical failure, or sealed reviewers find a worse critical architecture issue; time or priced cost may improve or worsen.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Record the failed gate, version a repair and start new assignments, never overwrite a failed attempt.

claim_effects.rationale: The intended intervention or outcome contrast is not established.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Affected units and endpoints; retain any unaffected descriptive measurements.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Retain all assignments and deviations; withhold clean presentation-effect inference for affected blocks.
hypothesis_effects: No differential mechanism adjudication in compromised blocks.
decision_matrix.next_action: Repair and re-freeze apparatus, then run a separate acquisition.
decision_matrix.observation_region: Semantic packet parity, source isolation, model match, timeout attestation or assessor calibration fails for a block.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: If invalidity rather than mere missing ancillary endpoint, use DM-004.

claim_effects.rationale: Missing or discordant evidence leaves the joint bounded benefit unresolved.
claim_effects.scope_limit: No claim for unmeasured review, cost or population.

decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report valid endpoint estimates and each unresolved dimension separately; do not promote a local point estimate to the full practical claim.
hypothesis_effects: H-001, H-002 and H-003 retain distinct system-specific possibilities.
decision_matrix.next_action: Complete masked review/billing if possible without altering outcomes; design a separately registered higher-information study.
decision_matrix.observation_region: Valid behaviour but review remains unresolved, charges incomplete, system effects conflict, or observed intervals are too wide for the practical threshold.

clean.forbidden_effect: No duplicate token or conflicting account event.
clean.public_fact: Issuer timeout occurred before its append and lookup for the stable account/request key returns no token.

defeated.forbidden_effect: No second issue call or duplicate AccessIssued event.
defeated.public_fact: Issuer appended a token before TimeoutError and lookup returns the matching committed token for this account/request ID.

entitlement.mechanism: After adding a pre-effect branch to issuer source before freeze, the D EAL source-order premise becomes contested in live coding; the probe states require different decisions.

clean.forbidden_effect: No new refund for the same applied key.
clean.public_fact: The same stable return request has provider status applied and one recorded refund effect under that key; remaining transitions can be reconciled without another refund.

defeated.forbidden_effect: No repeat refund, conflicting request, stock restoration or completion event until status resolves.
defeated.public_fact: Acknowledgement is unresolved, provider status for the stable key is unknown and the synthetic record contains no confirmed refund; neither application nor non-application can be inferred.

fulfilment.mechanism: An explicit unknown status defeats a provisional completion inference; independent sealed D tests exercise actual behaviour.

clean.forbidden_effect: No new booking IDs or duplicate event on replay.
clean.public_fact: Current active calendar bookings have no other-booking conflict for the requested bundle move; exclude only this bundle own IDs.

defeated.forbidden_effect: No mutation of bookings, commands or events.
defeated.public_fact: The historical bundle receipt suggests a former interval, but current active calendar index contains another booking overlapping the requested destination.

reservation.mechanism: Current active index defeats using a historical receipt as the availability authority; method-presence AST alone does not adjudicate runtime conflict.

decision_probe_plan.dry_mechanism_probe: The release-gate and AST-injection tests validate EAL mechanics only. The 54 live agent responses are on separately frozen, synthetic labelled finite-state source-linked cases, not production observations or candidate D implementation outcomes.
decision_probe_plan.exposure: Each session receives a registered host-only case source tree and a labelled synthetic public finite-state record constrained by its source/brief hashes, a common action menu, and the P1/P2 matched argument packet over that exact record; P0 sees source and the same record without argument packet. No D candidate or conversation enters the probe.

manifest_contract.metadata: study/decision_cases/cases.json with typed state path/digest, baseline source+brief SHA and host-only expected action

decision_probe_plan.oracle_handling: cases.json freezes IDs, typed public state path/hash, public source/brief SHA, allowed actions and a host-only expected action. The agent sees source/state/menu but not the exact expected_action field; a typed independent finite-state rule verifies that the frozen action follows the record. Strict final JSON enum scorer. This tests a decision on synthetic labelled input, not live provider behaviour or execution of the candidate D code.
readiness_blockers: Exact case source trees and typed public state records with baseline source/brief digests and independently reviewed hidden action oracle need to be frozen.
Runner must retain 54 isolated read-only 120-second sessions and classify timeout/parse failure.
Entitlement live coding source should contain both direct pre- and post-effect timeout branches before freeze so its actual D packet is contested; static decision probes remain a separate endpoint.
decision_probe_plan.schedule: After each D coding source seals, run two fresh read-only agent decision sessions on separate, registered host-owned case sources at study/decision_cases/<system>/{clean,defeated}/source. These case sources and state records are independent of the lineage D output; no transcript, modification or state carries between probes or back into coding.
decision_probe_plan.scope: Three systems x three triads x three arms x two cases = 54 agent decision-probe sessions; 120-second invocation cap each (6480 seconds = 1.8 hours maximum extra model invocation). Coding remains 81 B-C-D episodes.
decision_probe_plan.status: specified; live implementation and case-data parity gates pending

design.allocation_concealment: Versioned seed commitment and manifest before coding; reviewer mapping sealed until both architecture forms and adjudication are filed. Host operator may know treatment while constructing packets.
design.assignment_method: A precommitted seed yields a uniform P0/P1/P2 permutation over three masked clone IDs independently for each system-replicate triad.
design.comparator: Primary P2 EAL/2 rendering versus equally current and semantically matched P1 prose; P0 ordinary source/brief secondary.
design.masking: Assessor and architecture reviewers arm-masked where source content permits; agents cannot be masked to packet form. Record any identifier leakage.
design.rationale: Block each fresh B-C-D lineage by source system, task sequence and replicate; randomly assign three cloned instances to P0/P1/P2 and retain all attempts.
design.setting: Versioned offline software systems on isolated coding runners with host-only evidence and scoring.
design.temporal_structure: Sequential B to C to D within a clone, then two independently forked clean/defeated decision sessions without carry-over; three separately randomised triads per system.

estimands.interpretation: Bounded assignment effect on verified behaviour; an unsafe critical failure overrides a faster score.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Assign P2 for the entire B-C-D lineage.
estimands.population_or_system: The three registered finite codebases, fulfilment reported separately as calibration.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-system-weighted mean of within-triad P2-minus-P1 all-critical completion differences and full ordered status vectors.
estimands.time: At sealed B/C/D and whole-lineage completion.

estimands.interpretation: Whether EAL rendering alters correct withdrawal of a defeated provisional decision under matched content.
estimands.population_or_system: Frozen contested pairs across the three registered systems, calibration stratum distinct.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-system-weighted within-triad difference in paired correct-action-and-effect indicator, with clean and defeated components shown.
estimands.time: At due C/D candidate implementation assessments; independent standalone response effect is EST-006.

estimands.interpretation: Change-time decision score only, not causal future maintenance labour.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-system-weighted within-triad difference in failure-penalised seconds and ratio of system-standardised totals, with actual time and completion separately.
estimands.time: C and D, plus separate B-D lifecycle diagnostic.

estimands.interpretation: Bounded reviewer-observed architecture contrast; unresolved review gives unresolved endpoint.
estimands.population_or_system: Source snapshots from the same finite systems and triads.
estimands.summary_measure: Per-issue within-triad difference and registered critical no-worse disposition, preserving reviewer disagreement.
estimands.time: After each sealed change and before arm unblinding.

estimands.interpretation: Priced study expenditure, not debt value; incomplete billing cannot establish a money contrast.
estimands.population_or_system: The same finite triads when price and usage are complete.
estimands.summary_measure: Per-component, equal-system-weighted within-triad GBP difference and complete-case coverage; missing charges remain missing.
estimands.time: Host preparation and B-D coding through sealed output.

estimands.comparator: Assign P1 matched prose presentation in the corresponding clean and defeated sessions.
estimands.interpretation: Local assignment effect of argument presentation on explicit choices in these source-linked synthetic finite states; this does not establish candidate implementation behaviour or live-system decisions.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Assign P2 presentation in two fresh post-D case sessions.
estimands.population_or_system: Six frozen synthetic labelled decision-case records linked to three registered source trees, repeated in nine allocated triads; fulfilment is calibration.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-system-weighted within-triad difference in correctness of both case actions and pairwise action change; individual clean and defeated accuracies and invalid responses shown.
estimands.time: Two 120-second read-only post-D sessions, independent of D candidate source and one another.

mitigations: Short-lived scoped provider credential and artifact redaction with post-run audit.
Predeclared USD 15.00 conditional high list-rate scenario stop per block (USD 135.00 across nine); billed charges are not capped or inferred from CLI turns.
Offline fake adapters and deny-list/egress controls for production endpoints.
monitoring: Live job count, elapsed cap and accrued usage/estimated spend monitored per assignment.
Credential and external-effect log checked during acquisition.
post_stop_actions: Preserve immutable partial ledger and deviations.
Revoke affected credential, inspect effects and version any resumed study separately.
ethics_and_safety.rationale: Provider keys, paid coding-agent executions and simulated payment/entitlement decisions require bounded credential, spend and no-live-effects controls; no human participants or customer records are planned.
risks: Credential exposure in coding runner or artifacts.
Unintended live external effect if a fixture escapes its offline adapter.
ethics_and_safety.stop_authority: Study operator with authority to cancel the workflow and revoke credentials; exact identity recorded in pre-run manifest.
stopping_rules: Stop new launches on credential exposure or external-effect breach; retain completed and pending assignments as incomplete study.

Stop the affected block when conditional high list-rate scenario is unavailable or exceeds USD 15.00 after an invocation; retain crossing call and every previous assignment. This cannot cap actual invoice charges.

B.guidance: Use the account store as the current capacity and assignment authority; review atomic exchange and stable request keys against tests.
B.statement: The account assignment method is an inspectable source route; seat-capacity behaviour remains unverified.

C.guidance: Inspect current assignments under the account store, exact ordered displacement and effects of prior exchange history.
C.statement: The account release method is an inspectable source route; capacity-shrink behaviour remains unverified.

D.action_if_contested: Both pre-effect and after-effect timeout routes appear; distinguish them and reconcile each before retry.
D.action_if_supported: The source shows an after-effect timeout route; reconcile issuer.lookup before another issue call.
D.action_if_unknown: The source does not establish effect ordering; inspect outcome semantics and issuer.lookup before any retry.
D.guidance: The issuer may commit a token before the acknowledgement times out. Use issuer.lookup with the stable account and request ID before retrying, reject conflicting outcomes and avoid duplicate issuance.
D.statement: A direct append to issuer.issued before a direct TimeoutError appears in source order; dynamic reachability and external durability remain unverified.

B.guidance: Inspect refund amount, stable request key and compensation against the current service and visible tests; validate effects before acceptance.
B.statement: A refund method is a source-declared candidate effect route; stable-key and amount behaviour remain unverified.

C.guidance: Inspect cancellation key, remaining shipped units and refund/stock/event compensation together; validate retry effects.
C.statement: A shipping cancellation method is a source-declared candidate effect route; carrier outcome remains unverified.

D.action_if_unknown: The method is absent or source status is unresolved; add or inspect an explicit refund-status route and never infer not_applied from silence.
D.guidance: Treat a lost refund acknowledgement as an unknown outcome. Inspect a current stable-key provider status and reconcile other effects before marking complete or retrying; source syntax is not outcome evidence.
D.statement: The source may expose a refund-status inspection route; method presence does not establish applied, unapplied or unknown provider outcomes.

B.guidance: Inspect the active calendar booking index when reserving a bundle and reject the whole request if any room conflicts.
B.statement: The calendar conflict method is a source-declared availability route; bundle atomicity remains unverified.

C.guidance: Use current active calendar bookings for availability after a move, excluding only the bundle own booking IDs; the historical BundleReceipt cannot determine current availability.
C.statement: The calendar conflict method is an inspectable source route; current-index authority and move correctness remain unverified.

D.action_if_unknown: A current bundle cancellation path is not established by source inspection; inspect live booking index and implement coherent cancellation before relying on a receipt.
D.guidance: After a move, cancel the current active bundle bookings and preserve historical request replay; use current booking IDs from the calendar rather than only an old receipt.
D.statement: The source may expose a cancellation route; method presence does not verify which current bookings it cancels.

feasibility.access: Local deterministic fixtures and GitHub repository connection are available. Live model credential is expected from the repository Actions secret but must be checked by CI; provider invoice access and two independent masked reviewers are unverified.
apparatus_or_data: v3 host, EAL/2 evaluator, six cloned B-C-D lineages, synthetic release-gate cases and retained 63-artifact successful acquisition provide a starting harness.

v4 entitlement and reservation fixtures, hidden controls, corrected fulfilment assessor, packet parity and six finite-state decision cases passed deterministic tests. Revision 0.1.0 stopped at a nested CLI namespace. Revision 0.1.1 passed CLI isolation validation but nine first B invocations could not resolve the provider host, timed out at 1,800 seconds, and triggered the resource guard without completed turns. Unlaunched 0.1.2 received an independent preflight review; revision 0.1.3 requires a new freeze and credential-free effective-route check before connected model acquisition.
blockers: The live credential and provider billing identity remain unverified. The nested Codex sandbox failed in run 36341669596; the outer-only CLI launched in run 36342146781 but its isolated resolver could not reach api.openai.com. Revision 0.1.3 effective-route preflight has not yet been observed in CI.
Independent masked architecture reviewers are not yet assigned; retain that endpoint as pending if none complete forms.
The conditional list-rate cap does not guarantee a billed-currency ceiling.
dependencies: Corrected and versioned refund assessor and brief.
Two genuine further systems with frozen source, briefs, collectors, EAL argument, visible tests and sealed oracles.
Common FactSet/DecisionContent parity renderer and multi-system runner/assembler/analyser.
Two masked reviewers plus adjudicator, tariff/billing source and live credential checks.
Host-only paired public source-state facts, exact action-menu oracle and isolated after-D decision-probe runner with 120-second cap.
feasibility.fallback: Run deterministic dry apparatus checks without model calls; retain the v3 analysis as exploratory until all independent-system and live gates pass.
resources: 81 x 1800 = 145800 coding-invocation seconds (40.5 hours) plus 54 x 120 = 6480 decision-probe seconds (1.8 hours), maximum 42.3 model-invocation hours; excludes host, queue, install, scoring and review.
Operational guard: USD 15.00 per block, USD 135.00 nine-block aggregate under the upper conditional Standard API list-rate scenario; actual billed USD and billing contract remain unknown.
Thirty-minute cap per episode; nominal token target is advisory unless technically enforced.
skills: System-specific assessor construction and adversarial oracle review.
EAL/2 argument rendering and content parity validation.
Blocked randomisation, cost accounting and masked architecture review.

hypotheses.label: Formal defeater presentation helps
hypotheses.scope: Frozen clean/defeated case pairs in the registered B-C-D tasks.
hypotheses.statement: With matched semantic content, P2 more often changes a defeated provisional action to the correct safe action than P1 without losing sealed conformance.

hypotheses.label: Explicit information suffices
hypotheses.scope: The same matched case pairs and agent/runner configuration.
hypotheses.statement: An equally explicit plain account of the same defeater and recommendation causes the same verified safe decision and implementation as formal presentation.

hypotheses.label: Formal presentation friction
hypotheses.scope: The registered treatment, resources and review horizon.
hypotheses.statement: Formal status and routes lead to more unsafe deference, mistakes or work than the matched plain account on contested cases.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Conditional randomisation identifies finite-triad assignment effects once systems, interventions, source oracles and acquisition exist. Present apparatus lacks complete distinct anchors, packet parity, sealed review and price coverage; presentation-only, architecture and monetary estimands are not identified at this knowledge cut. B/C source states mediate the lineage assignment effect and must not be adjusted away.
diagnostics: Packet semantic parity and access traces.
Masked reviewer completion and charge coverage.
identified_parameters: After gates pass, within-triad intention-to-treat contrasts for included lineages can be estimated from all assigned outcomes.
nonidentified_alternatives: Information advantage when P2 contains statuses absent from P1.
Model/runner drift, leakage or source-selected tasks.
Population-of-systems effect beyond the chosen finite codebases.
Financial totals with absent rate or token classes.
rescue_actions: Build and independently check two more genuine systems and reference implementations.
Implement common FactSet/DecisionContent renderers and parity rejection gate.
Freeze brief/assessor reconciliation, reviewers, tariffs and allocation before coding.
threats: Only one v3 source anchor exists at initial design cut.
Masked architecture review and full billed cost were not acquired in v3.
Assessor requirements may mismatch task briefs until separately corrected.

interventions_or_exposures.description: P2: source-bound EAL/2 argument with explicit premises, objections, grounded status and decision guidance.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One current packet before each B/C/D stage; matched retrieval affordance if used.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Render canonical DecisionContent as EAL/2 via host MCP, bound to exact current source and selected brief; retain request/response and delivery digest.
manipulation_checks: Source and fact digest match candidate input.
P1/P2 semantic parity and access equivalence pass.
off_target_checks: Model/prompt/tool/cap equality, length and timing differences recorded.
No hidden/future material reachable by agent.
recovery_checks: Fresh revised source causes re-evaluation rather than stale packet reuse.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Argument representation in the agent's decision context.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Before each stage's coding starts, following the prior stage's sealed source carry-over.

interventions_or_exposures.description: P1: equally current plain account of all source facts, defeaters, statuses and selected guidance.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: One packet per stage with the same facts and ability to inspect explanations as P2.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Render the same canonical DecisionContent in complete prose, including qualified conclusion and blocking reason.
manipulation_checks: P1 conveys every relevant proposition and recommended action.
No EAL-only status information survives parity audit.
off_target_checks: Token-length sensitivity and shared common preamble.
recovery_checks: Rescored after each prior stage's source change.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Immediately before each B/C/D coding stage on that lineage's current source.

interventions_or_exposures.description: P0: ordinary cloned source, visible tests, architecture document and current brief without an additional evidence packet.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Stage only normal candidate-visible repository materials.
off_target_checks: Same source anchor, visible tests, model class and wall cap.
recovery_checks: Continue same lineage after nonpassing stage where safely possible.

measurements.blinding: Assessor receives source with arm sidecars removed; reviewers do not see automated findings before sealing.
measurements.calibration: Brief-oracle reconciliation and positive/negative implementations before dispatch.
measurements.error_model: Import/assessor failures marked invalid; missing snapshot is acquisition failure, never zero failures.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Versioned host-only system assessor replayed on candidate snapshot and independent reference fixtures.
measurements.measurement_invariance: System-specific tests differ, but pass policy and critical categorisation are registered and applied to all arms.
measurements.observable: Ordered due probe status, critical-failure count, invalid count and all-stage completion for each immutable candidate.
measurements.preprocessing: Freeze probe IDs and due-stage vector; invalid stays invalid rather than fail or pass.
measurements.reactivity: Sealed probes are hidden; visible tests are common across arms.
measurements.reliability: Byte-identical assessor replay and repeated clean/faulty fixture controls.
measurements.scale_or_units: Categorical pass/fail/invalid and binary lineage completion; probes are dependent within lineage.
measurements.timing: After B, C and D coding seals a source digest; no feedback to the agent.
measurements.validity: Bounded functional conformance only for listed cases.

measurements.blinding: The sealed executable oracle and scoring remain host-only; agent sees the public brief but not cases.
measurements.calibration: Independent oracle adjudication of contrasting premises and recovery cases.
measurements.error_model: Missing answer or executable path is recorded separately from a wrong action; assessor error invalid.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Frozen independent action oracle and sealed executable scenario rig on the candidate source; this is distinct from the static synthetic probe state in M-007.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same case pair within each triad, with domain-specific oracle registered per system.
measurements.observable: Sealed implementation effects in each coded B-C-D candidate on clean and defeated states; standalone agent decisions are measured separately in M-007.
measurements.preprocessing: Score both clean and defeated states; blanket BLOCK is incorrect on admissible clean states.
measurements.reactivity: Cases remain host-only; current public facts are delivered identically to P1/P2.
measurements.reliability: Replay oracle rig against positive and intentionally wrong reference sources.
measurements.scale_or_units: Correct/incorrect/invalid for each scenario and pairwise decision change per lineage.
measurements.timing: Due C or D implementation assessor after sealed candidate code.
measurements.validity: Action selection in these declared source states; no evidence of live-provider decisions.

measurements.blinding: Random candidate IDs without packets, agent reports, arm labels or sealed assessor results.
measurements.calibration: Review common baseline and marked example before coding; freeze rubric anchors.
measurements.error_model: Unresolved or unmasked review leaves architecture endpoint unresolved.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Two independent condition-masked reviewers using a frozen six-issue system-adapted rubric; third adjudicator.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same abstract issue rubric with explicit system-specific responsibilities, all arms blind.
measurements.observable: Per-finding source locations, present/absent/unresolved status, alternatives, reviewer disagreement and adjudication.
measurements.preprocessing: Preserve originals and disagreement; determine prespecified critical no-worse only after adjudication.
measurements.reactivity: Reviewer cannot influence already sealed code; agent source may contain arm-identifying language.
measurements.reliability: Report per-issue agreement and disagreement, including unresolved findings.
measurements.scale_or_units: Categorical findings; no unvalidated composite score.
measurements.timing: After immutable snapshot, before arm key release or automated outcome disclosure.
measurements.validity: Source structure and identified effect routes, not future maintenance labour.

measurements.blinding: Timestamps collected automatically before arm-unmasked analysis.
measurements.calibration: Runner clock and cap probe in dry run; verify start/stop records and no overlapping double counts.
measurements.error_model: Unknown elapsed or unenforced cap invalidates time contrast for affected block; failure penalty shown in sensitivity analysis.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Host monotonic timestamps and enforced 1800-second coding-invocation timeout.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same cap and score across arms and systems; systems retain their separate elapsed components.
measurements.observable: Actual coding wall time, cap event, host acquisition wall, queue and assessor wall separately.
measurements.preprocessing: Q=min(T,1800) only for complete episode, otherwise Q=1800; add C+D host preparation once.
measurements.reactivity: Timeout may prevent completion; same limit applied to all arms.
measurements.reliability: Replay score from retained immutable event ledger.
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds per stage and summed failure-penalised score per lineage.
measurements.timing: Start coding action to sealed source; host packet preparation immediately before each stage.
measurements.validity: Decision score and actual process interval; excludes future hidden-defect remediation.

measurements.blinding: Tariff and accounting rule registered before outcome unmasking.
measurements.calibration: Compare a known-usage trace and independently billed sample; verify cache-write billing definition.
measurements.error_model: Absent usage/rate class yields missing total and optional bounded scenario, never an imputed zero.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Raw CLI events, dated tariff snapshot or bill and measured host/runner resources.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same rate convention for arms in a block, with observed SKU drift retained.
measurements.observable: Raw uncached input, cache-read, cache-write, output and reasoning token classes, call counts, model SKU, provider bill/estimate and runner/collector use.
measurements.preprocessing: Subtract cached-read subset from total input before uncached rate; apply class prices once; preserve unknown separately from zero.
measurements.reactivity: Collection does not feed an agent; rate choices can alter interpretation, so freeze them.
measurements.reliability: Replay arithmetic from trace digest, rate source and selected tariff class.
measurements.scale_or_units: Tokens and resource seconds; GBP only when rate/currency coverage is complete.
measurements.timing: Every assigned attempt including failure and packet acquisition; rate snapshot before dispatch.
measurements.validity: Observed or transparently priced expenditure for this study, not debt cost.

measurements.blinding: Content reviewers inspect packets before coding outcomes; coding agents see only their assigned rendering.
measurements.calibration: Known mismatched-status, stale-source and missing-defeater adversarial fixtures must be rejected.
measurements.error_model: Unresolved equivalence or different access suspends representation-only inference.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: One FactSet and DecisionContent rendered into P1 prose and P2 EAL/2; parity verifier and independent review.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same parity criteria across all systems and stage families.
measurements.observable: Canonical normalised-content digest, proposition-equivalence verdict, packet token length and access/delivery trace.
measurements.preprocessing: Strip only arm-specific syntax, reorder/normalise source identities, compare all semantically relevant fields and record differences.
measurements.reactivity: Parity check occurs before agent exposure and may prevent dispatch of invalid packet.
measurements.reliability: Deterministic renderer/normaliser digest replay and dual-review agreement.
measurements.scale_or_units: Equivalent/non-equivalent/unresolved and byte/token counts per paired source state.
measurements.timing: Dry validation and every current B/C/D input snapshot before coding.
measurements.validity: Tests semantic information parity, not whether an agent attended to it.

measurements.blinding: Expected action is host-only; agent sees only public source, state record and common action menu.
measurements.calibration: Independent review of typed public case records and oracle, positive/defeated pairs, source/brief digest checks and fixed scorer examples.
measurements.error_model: Timeout, absent final JSON and invalid enum are separate; source/state mismatch suspends probe contrast.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Host-owned synthetic labelled finite-state records and registered case source under study/decision_cases/<system>/<case_id>/source, a typed rule cross-checking the frozen oracle, decision_probe.generate and strict decision_probe.score; 120-second fresh read-only agent session per case.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same case source/state/action menu for three arms within each system block; domain-specific action oracles kept separate.
measurements.observable: Strict JSON action enum for clean and defeated registered case sources, response validity, timeout and pairwise action change per assigned arm.
measurements.preprocessing: Score exact predeclared enum; keep missing/invalid response separate from wrong action; aggregate two cases as one paired arm/block outcome.
measurements.reactivity: Explicit action request can focus attention differently from unconstrained coding; identical prompt across arms.
measurements.reliability: Replay state-source derivation, prompt/hash generation and strict response parsing from raw trace.
measurements.scale_or_units: Correct/incorrect/invalid per probe and correct pair indicator; 54 attempts across 27 coding lineages.
measurements.timing: Two fresh isolated probes after D candidate seals, with no D source or conversation carried into the probes.
measurements.validity: Direct agent decision over labelled synthetic source-linked cases, not executable D implementation, a live provider or future maintenance.

predictions.direction: Positive P2-minus-P1 decision accuracy with no adverse critical-behaviour contrast.
predictions.expected_pattern: P2 has more correct clean-to-defeated decision changes than P1 while its critical-conformance rate is not lower in the registered systems.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Report observed system-weighted difference and interval; a meaningful threshold and conformance noninferiority margin require pre-run justification and freeze.
predictions.time_window: At the due B, C or D sealed assessor and post-run decision check. The separate two 120-second agent decision responses occur after D.
predictions.tolerance: Exact oracle actions and effects; assessor invalidity is never a pass.

predictions.direction: Near-zero differential decision accuracy subject to a declared equivalence tolerance.
predictions.expected_pattern: P1 and P2 both change correctly on the contested pair and have compatible sealed conformance; shared success cannot isolate an EAL advantage.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: No equivalence claim until an action-risk-based tolerance and adequate interval precision are registered.
predictions.time_window: At each due sealed decision and implementation check. The separate two 120-second agent decision responses occur after D.
predictions.tolerance: An observed tie is descriptive unless its uncertainty excludes meaningful differences.

predictions.direction: Adverse P2-minus-P1 sign on at least one prespecified endpoint.
predictions.expected_pattern: P2 has more unsafe actions, critical failures, adverse architecture findings or a larger failure-penalised time score than matched P1.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Report endpoint-specific magnitude and uncertainty; no composite architecture or money score substitutes for critical behaviour.
predictions.time_window: B-C-D completion and sealed post-run review. The separate two 120-second agent decision responses occur after D.
predictions.tolerance: An additional critical unsafe effect is materially adverse even if elapsed time is lower.

provenance.knowledge_cut: The v3 outputs preceded design version 0.1.0; validation run 36341669596 failed before v4 live calls, and run 36342146781 made nine timed-out, DNS-blocked first B invocations with no completed model turns. Unlaunched local 0.1.2 was superseded after preflight review. No connected v4 coding or decision outcome has been observed for revision 0.1.3.

question: In three registered software systems, does presenting matched current source facts, defeaters and guidance as an EAL/2 argument rather than semantically equivalent prose improve agents' verified later-change decisions and implementations without worse architecture, time or priced resource use?

reproducibility.code_plan: Pin Git tree, lockfile, dependencies, assessor and EAL tool bindings; replay assemblers, assessors, cost calculation and finite-system summaries from retained immutable snapshots.
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain exact trial source trees, input/output hashes, packet digests, delivery and CLI traces, assessor vectors, independent reviewer forms, invoices/rate snapshots and all deviations; copy expiring CI artifacts to durable storage. Retain all 54 post-D probe prompts, source/state facts and digests, responses, usage, timeout and parse statuses.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Append versioned amendments and all failed attempts; never overwrite the v3 freeze or reclassify repaired R/W as unseen independent confirmation.
immutable_materials: B/C/D briefs, visible and sealed tests, clean/defeated cases, assessor and expected action oracles.
EAL argument, common facts/decision-content renderers, parity validator, rubric, analysis, allocation seed commitment and model/price/cap manifest.
Two source-linked synthetic clean/defeated decision records per system, their common action menu, host-only action oracle and 120-second cap.
study/decision_cases/cases.json, per-case public source trees and typed state records with source/brief digests and host-only action oracle.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Record source revision, git blob and tree digests, case/brief authorship, timestamps, model/CLI versions, unknown backend revisions, price-source date and all raw response IDs.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Record independent seed commitments and uniform P0/P1/P2 permutations for each of nine system-replicate triads; reveal full allocation after reviewer seal; preserve scheduling order.
reproducibility.registration: This version is a specified draft in repository; no immutable preregistration exists. Freeze a new version with timestamped digests before coding.
reproducibility.replication_plan: The first three-system wave estimates finite-system patterns; a separately registered unseen-system sample and simulation-based information target are required for confirmation.

sampling.attrition_or_loss: All assigned failures, partial episodes, delivery errors and early stops remain in the ledger; do not replace them with successful retries.
sampling.dependence_structure: Stages and probes nest inside a lineage; three lineages form one randomised triad; triads nest within independently developed systems. Resample/randomise only assignment units respecting blocks.
inputs: Within-system stochastic session variability and stage carry-over to measure in the new calibration wave.
System heterogeneity and correlation across task families.
Cost cap and a justified practical effect and correctness margin before confirmatory sample sizing.
sampling.method: Fixed feasibility replication followed by a separately registered precision/power simulation for any confirmation.
sampling.multiplicity: Behaviour and contested decision are co-primary interpretive endpoints; time, architecture and money are separately reported with no composite win count. Predeclare any formal multiplicity correction before confirmation.
sampling.result: The fixed first wave can bound mechanisms and estimate finite-system contrasts; three systems cannot calibrate a reliable population variance or establish a 25% improvement with narrow confidence bounds by fiat.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Three systems x three independently randomised three-arm triads x three stages = 27 coding lineages and 81 episodes, plus 54 isolated post-D paired decision-probe sessions (two per lineage). Fulfilment is a prior-observed calibration stratum; this is a bounded information target, not a power claim.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Vary failure-penalty cap in declared alternatives; inspect outcomes by system and model drift and missing billing bounds; do not condition on post-treatment pass.
sampling.stopping_implications: Stop after 81 coding episodes and 54 registered 120-second decision-probe attempts unless a predeclared budget/safety or validity gate stops acquisition; retain incomplete study if stopped early.

scope.conditions: Fresh isolated coding-agent sessions, matched model and tool profile within each three-arm block and stage, current source-bound packets and a 30-minute invocation cap per episode.
exclusions: The prior v3 R/W outcomes do not enter the new effect estimate.
The synthetic release-gate replay is an apparatus check, not an independent coding system.
General software-system, human-engineer, future-debt and live-provider effects are outside scope.
scope.knowledge_cut: 2026-09-27: run 36334071057 and v3 source commit 42e0381f21e73f436a0de0462544ec7b052bc49b observed before this design
scope.spatial_scope: Isolated cloned source trees, host-only packet and assessor processes, and the registered CI or equivalent runner; no live payment, cloud deployment or customer state.
scope.system_or_population: The three eventual registered codebases and their frozen B-C-D task banks; fulfilment is a previously observed calibration stratum, and two additional systems are independent-system development replications.
scope.temporal_scope: Each assigned B-C-D coding lineage, then two independent 120-second decision probes after D on clean and defeated states, plus sealed assessment, masked review and cost accounting; no future maintenance horizon.

title: Matched EAL/2 argument presentation across independently assigned software-change sequences

units.analysis_unit: One whole-lineage outcome per arm, differenced within triad, summarised first by system and then equally across the finite systems. For standalone decisions, one clean/defeated pair per system/block/arm is the analysis unit; repeated same case across blocks is model-session variation, not extra systems.
units.assignment_unit: The whole lineage, randomised within a system-task-replicate triad; three stages never count as separate assignments.
exclusion_criteria: Renamed or copied fulfilment fixture presented as another system.
Task bank selected or assessor corrected after its own treatment outcome has been inspected without a new version and status label.
units.experimental_unit: One independently cloned B-C-D lineage receiving one assigned arm throughout.
inclusion_criteria: Exact frozen source anchor and B/C/D briefs, runnable offline baseline and hidden assessor.
Three independent clean clone/agent sessions and matched tool/model configuration.
Current-snapshot source facts and registered clean/defeated action oracle.
units.observational_unit: Stage snapshot and its assessor vector, packet/cost/time records, contested case pair and masked review finding. Each standalone post-D probe response is an additional observational unit; two probes are paired by system/block and assigned arm.
units.recruitment_or_selection: Register the systems by source history, domain independence, licence, deterministic offline testability and feasible 30-minute tasks before any new coding result; do not select successful clones.
units.sampling_frame: The known fulfilment A snapshot plus new independently sourced systems meeting frozen pre-outcome executable eligibility criteria; no random sample of all software.
units.target_population_or_system: Exactly the three prospectively registered codebases; fulfilment analysed as prior-observed calibration, two independent new systems separately.
